mode: self-hosted server (Docker), per-bank MCP endpoint over Streamable HTTP, bank 'adebench'
door: recall(query, budget="mid", max_tokens=2000) on the bank's MCP endpoint
results: budget mid and no min_scores (deployment defaults); max_tokens 2000 (adapter default); no score floor (ADEBENCH_HINDSIGHT_MIN_SCORE 0), no cut
model: gemini-3.5-flash-lite (Google): extracts facts, entities and relations on every retain
not_default: HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_MODEL=gemini-3.5-flash-lite instead of gemini-3.5-flash, the model the docs name (it answered 503 all day of the run); prompt caching off (HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_PROMPT_CACHE_ENABLED=false, reason not stated)
